newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry was moderate and demand light. Sales confirmed for the week to date on 12,200 head including 10,400 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Bids $66.00 per cwt, asking prices $68.00-$69.00, last established price $67.00 on Thursday, March 20.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none last week - 34,800 last year - 1,100
Wk to date- 12,200 last week - 47,300 last year - 69,700
